categories.name: Plants & planters

categories.name: Clocks & mirrors

categories.name: Objects
categories.description: Sculpture, bowls and baskets: the things that finish a room.

products.name: Pebble Carafe Vase
products.short_description: A tall glazed stoneware carafe with a pinched lip, for a single stem or a loose branch.
products.description:
Thrown on the wheel, then pinched at the lip while the clay is still soft, so no two are quite the same.

The glaze is food-safe and watertight.

products.name: Dune Stoneware Vase
products.short_description: Wide-shouldered and matt, with a raw stoneware texture.
products.description:
A broad, sturdy vase with a dry matt finish that shows the grain of the clay.

Big enough for a full bunch of hydrangeas or a few branches of eucalyptus.

products.name: Delft Blue Vase
products.short_description: Hand-painted cobalt blossoms on a tall porcelain body.
products.description:
A tall porcelain vase painted by hand in cobalt blue with branches of blossom, in the tradition of Delft and Jingdezhen.

Turn it round in 3D to see that the pattern runs all the way around.

products.name: Engraved Brass Vase
products.short_description: A small footed vase in spun brass, engraved by hand.
products.description:
Spun from a single sheet of brass, then engraved by hand with a band of leaves.

Left unlacquered, so it darkens slowly to a warm patina.

products.name: Ficus Tree in Terracotta
products.short_description: A lifelike faux ficus, 135 cm tall, in a footed terracotta urn.
products.description:
All the green of a small ficus tree without the watering, the dropped leaves or the search for the right window.

The urn is real terracotta, weighted so the tree stands steady.

products.name: Arrowhead Plant in Clay Bowl
products.short_description: A faux syngonium with arrow-shaped leaves in a wide terracotta bowl.
products.description:
Broad, veined leaves spill over the rim of a low terracotta bowl. It looks freshly potted every day of the year.

Wipe the leaves with a damp cloth to keep them bright.

products.name: Zebra Haworthia
products.short_description: A striped succulent in a white glazed pot. Faux, so it never needs water.
products.description:
A small succulent for a desk or a bathroom shelf, with white-striped leaves in a glazed pot.

It sits happily in rooms with no daylight at all.

products.name: Westminster Mantel Clock
products.short_description: A walnut-veneer tambour case with a silvered dial and brass bezel.
products.description:
The classic tambour shape, in walnut veneer polished by hand, with a silvered dial behind a hinged brass bezel.

A silent sweep movement means no tick in a quiet room.

products.name: Twin-Bell Alarm Clock
products.short_description: A mint-green twin-bell alarm clock with a loud, honest ring.
products.description:
Two chrome bells and a hammer: the alarm clock that actually wakes you up.

Wind the alarm on the back, set the red hand and it rings at the time you chose.

products.name: Arched Gilt Mirror
products.short_description: An arched mirror in a carved giltwood frame.
products.description:
A tall arch of bevelled mirror glass in a carved frame finished in water gilding, with a crest of scrolls at the top.

Hang it over a console or lean it on a mantel.
products.materials: Carved wood, gold leaf, bevelled mirror glass

products.name: Classical Marble Bust
products.short_description: A cast marble bust after a Roman original.
products.description:
Cast from crushed marble and resin after a Roman portrait bust, then finished by hand for a soft, honed surface.

Heavy enough to stand on a plinth or a bookshelf without moving.

products.name: Carved Teak Elephant
products.short_description: A small elephant carved by hand from a single block of teak.
products.description:
Carved by hand from one piece of reclaimed teak and finished with beeswax.

Pick the natural teak or the ebonised finish.

products.name: Burl Wood Bowl
products.short_description: Turned from a single piece of burl, so no two are alike.
products.description:
Burl is the knotted, swirling growth on the side of a tree. Turned on the lathe, it shows a pattern that is different in every bowl.

For keys, fruit or nothing at all. Oil it now and then to keep the colour deep.

products.name: Lidded Wicker Basket
products.short_description: Hand-woven rattan on short legs, with a lift-off lid.
products.description:
Woven by hand from rattan around a light frame, with short legs that keep it off a damp floor.

For throws, toys or laundry.
